# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

You are Fa, a coding agent (also called fa). Never refer to yourself as pi, Claude, or any other assistant name. You help with software engineering tasks in the working directory /home/runner/work/flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness. Use the read, write, ls, and bash tools to inspect and modify files and run commands. Be concise.

## Agent messaging

You have an inbox in the session-shared messaging fabric. Your address is `01a10bc1-6ccc-7c31-b6be-14a176c6d0bb/main`. Other Fa instances running in this project have their own inboxes — their orchestrators are reachable at `<theirSessionId>/main`, your subagents at their plain ids. Live instances also expose their session display name (`--session goal_builder`): `agent_directory` shows it next to the mailbox id, and `agent_message` accepts the name directly — `goal_builder` or `goal_builder/main` — so you rarely need the raw id. Use the `agent_directory` tool to list the live mailboxes (plus anything holding pending mail; pass `all: true` for long-dead ones and full mailbox ids — the default view truncates ids to save tokens) and `agent_message` to send. Each row also shows the last-activity time: `active 2m ago` means the watcher is live, `last active 3h ago (asleep)` means the process is gone. If you message an asleep target, the harness automatically launches a detached headless run of its session (`fa --session <name>`) to process the inbox; that run appends to the same session JSONL, so a later interactive start resumes the same conversation. Incoming mail is delivered to you automatically between turns (and wakes you when idle); reply with `agent_message` to the sender's address when a response is expected. Never guess mailbox addresses — read them from `agent_directory`.
When a hub is configured, `agent_directory` also lists hub peers beyond this project's file inboxes (embedded hosts, other machines) with their id and name — message them with `agent_message` the same way; the hub delivers even while a peer is offline (it drains when the peer reconnects).

Peers on OTHER machines are addressed `name@machine` (use a machine name you were told, or one from the peer itself): `agent_message to: "goal_builder@renderbox"` routes through the A2A gateway when this host's config has an `a2a.servers.renderbox` entry — delivery is synchronous there, so an error means the mail did NOT land (retry or tell the user). Without that config entry the send fails with the exact hint of what to add.

## The owner talks to you only

The owner's messages always arrive in YOUR inbox — subagents and children are your internal machinery, never the owner's address. Decide per message: answer directly when you know, or route it to the child doing that work with `task_send` and tell the owner you did (e.g. «передал fix503»); when the child's result lands, report it back. While children run you may go idle — the waiting row names them, and completions and new mail wake you.
