# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: gh-1266 regression test lives under the `gh-1164 review hardening` group**

This new test guards the gh-1266 raw-string invariant, but it was appended inside the `group('gh-1164 review hardening (host-side, no live engine)')` block (declared at line 2642). Thematically it is *adjacent* (the fingerprint block it protects was introduced by gh-1164), so this is not wrong — but a reader scanning groups for gh-1266 coverage will not find it there.

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

- ❌ test/apps/js_theme_test.dart: engine theme plumbing initialTheme reaches JS and updateTheme fires

Five failures in ONE feature area (apps panel / app launcher / dynamic-message tiles) = a regression, not flake. Recent merges touching that code (last 3 days): **b343c68d8 feat(#866) apps panel reflects reality (#1139)** and 6244a390d fix(#1175) one-Fa-one-session FAB (#1173) — prime suspects in that order.

**Acceptance:**
- AC1: macOS suite green in nightly.
- AC2: the breaking commit is named; if a test expectation was intentionally changed by #1139/#1173, the PR that changes the test explains the intended new behavior.
- AC3: if the cluster only fails on CI-macOS (passes locally), say so explicitly and deflake à la #1166 instead of force-adjusting expectations.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1278
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1278
- **Title**: gh-1266 [BUG] nightly red: macOS flutter_app suite — 5-test cluster around apps panel / open_app launcher / dynamic_message tiles (suspects #1139, #1173)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1266` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 93
- **Additions**: +92
- **Deletions**: -5
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:13:09Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:03:54Z

## PR Description

### Root Cause
The 5-test cluster shares one root: the JS-app bootstrap in `JsAppEngine` could not parse on any host where the JS engine actually loads (macOS JavaScriptCore in nightly; Linux QuickJS reproduces it via the issue #184 guard's `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`). Two defects in the gh-1164 fingerprint block of `_faBootstrapJs`: (1) it is a **non-raw** Dart string, so Dart converted the JS `\n`/`\t`/`\r` escapes into real control characters — the regex `/[ \t\r\n]+/g` gained a literal line terminator → `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`; (2) the whitespace-collapse replacement was corrupt — `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` with an unterminated string literal. Bootstrap and widget code are one eval script, so the parse error killed every engine boot: app tiles, dynamic-message tiles, `open_app` navigation, and the launcher smoke gate. Ubuntu CI never saw it because those tests SKIP without the native QuickJS bridge. A second, binding-less-lifecycle bug surfaced once the engine could boot: `JsAppEngine._inWidgetTest` probed `WidgetsBinding.instance` unguarded and threw in plain `test()`s (`open_app_tool_test`).

### Fix
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`:
  - `_faBootstrapJs` is now a raw string (`r'''`) — JS escapes reach the engine verbatim; comment documents the invariant.
  - Repaired both `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ')` lines to `.replace(/[ \t\r\n]+/g, ' ')`.
  - `_inWidgetTest` probes `BindingBase.debugBindingType()` instead of `WidgetsBinding.instance` (null-safe when no binding is initialized).
- `flutter_app/test/apps/open_app_tool_test.dart`: `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at `main()` — flutter_js's fetch bootstrap loads its polyfill via the root asset bundle, which needs the services binding once the engine really boots.
- New regression tests: `js_app_engine_test.dart` asserts the bootstrap keeps its JS escape sequences and quoted replacement; `js_app_engine_no_binding_test.dart` (new file, deliberately binding-free) guards dispose without a widget binding.

### Test Coverage
- All 5 nightly failures verified FAIL pre-fix and PASS post-fix with a live QuickJS engine forced via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` (the exact nightly symptoms: `SyntaxError: unexpected line terminator in regexp`, empty uiTree/exported state).
- Nightly scope, default CI config: `flutter test test/apps test/integration/dynamic_message_*_test.dart test/chat_screen_test.dart` — **451 passed, 0 failed**.
- Full suite (all except integration + goldens): **3404 passed, 53 failed** — the 49 real failures are byte-identical to a base-commit (`fc23b43`) run of the same files (CLI-visual PTY, wasm toolchain, providers-queue IO — pre-existing Linux-environment issues, zero regressions; 4 extra are helper .dart files pulled in as entrypoints by my glob, not test failures).

### Notes
- **AC2**: the ticket's suspects (#1139/#1173) are not the cause — the regression lives in the gh-1164 bootstrap block. The checkout's git history is squashed, so the exact breaking commit cannot be named.
- **AC3**: not a macOS-only flake — the failures are deterministic wherever the JS engine loads; reproducing locally on Linux only requires pointing `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` at the flutter_js-bundled bridge.
- Out of scope, observed while forcing the engine: `js_app_error_capture_test.dart` has 2 tests that fail ONLY on the QuickJS path (flutter_js jsonDecodes the `__jsr_log` payload, so the `{iid,id}` wrapper reaches `_handleLog` as a Map; the JSC/macOS path unwraps it). They pass on macOS nightly and skip on Ubuntu CI — pre-existing divergence in the vendored `flutter_js_widget_runtime`, left untouched.
- `[REDACTED:Credential File]` placeholder was created locally (gitignored, mirrors the CI workflow's `touch .env`).
